body:
Hi @zackify, this shouldn't happen normally as we perform a deepEqual when a component receive new props. So if the props didn't changed, the onSearchStateChange shouldn't be trigger infinitely. 

But sometimes depending on the upper component of the `<InstantSearch/>` root component, those infinite loops can still happen, for example in the `react-router v3` recipe I had to implement the `shouldComponentUpdate` lifecycle method. 

Any chance you can provide a small sample to help us understand what's happening with your use case? Maybe you can use this jsfiddle template https://jsfiddle.net/h3nus3gg/?
